site_controls.active_unequal_site_control: At least two active sites must have unequal K_j so I-versus-J binding produces an exact nonzero discriminator.
site_controls.inactive_site_control: A site with selected kinetic rate exactly zero must remain qnew_j == qold_j exactly under both selectors.
site_controls.identical_site_control: When compared sites have identical K, selector substitution is intentionally non-discriminating and must not be used as positive evidence.

route_controls.inactive_natural_route: Supplied active-P B0 cases use Optcxsl=3; TCD-024 candidate must be exactly inert there.
route_controls.TCD019_separation: No TCD-019 policy change may be included in the B3B03 candidate or used to define its pass condition.
